summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus filed by BA Credit Card Funding, LLC (transferor/depositor) and BA Credit Card Trust (issuing entity) for the issuance of $1.5 billion Class A(2026-1) asset-backed notes. The notes are secured by a collateral certificate representing an undivided interest in BA Master Credit Card Trust II's credit card receivables. This is a routine securitization offering under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing details interest rate (4.22%), expected principal payment (April 2029), legal maturity (April 2031), underwriting discount, and credit enhancement via subordination. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is involved.
